skills.name: Fraction Subtraction
skills.definition: Subtracting numerators of fractions with identical denominators.

skills.name: Common Denominator Conversion
skills.definition: Finding the lowest common denominator and converting unlike fractions to equivalent fractions.

skills.name: Whole Number Subtraction
skills.definition: Subtracting the whole number parts of mixed numbers or whole numbers.

skills.name: Regrouping and Borrowing
skills.definition: Borrowing from the whole number part and converting it to fraction form to resolve negative fraction differences.

skills.name: Fraction Simplification
skills.definition: Reducing a fraction to its lowest terms.
